descriptions.zh-CN: 对量化权重执行矩阵乘法，通常承担 Prefill 阶段的大部分线性层计算。
descriptions.en-US: Multiplies activations by quantized weights and commonly dominates linear layers during prefill.

descriptions.zh-CN: 对单 Token 激活与量化权重执行矩阵向量乘法，是 Decode 阶段的核心计算。
descriptions.en-US: Performs matrix-vector multiplication with quantized weights and is a core decode-stage operation.

descriptions.zh-CN: 使用浮点权重执行矩阵向量乘法，常用于未量化张量或中间投影。
descriptions.en-US: Performs floating-point matrix-vector multiplication for unquantized tensors or intermediate projections.

descriptions.zh-CN: 由 AMD Tensile/rocBLAS 生成的 GEMM Kernel，名称中包含 Tile、Matrix Instruction 和 Wave 配置。
descriptions.en-US: An AMD Tensile or rocBLAS generated GEMM kernel whose symbol encodes tile, matrix-instruction, and wave settings.

descriptions.zh-CN: 以分块方式融合注意力分数、Softmax 和 Value 聚合，减少显存读写，主要用于 Prefill。
descriptions.en-US: Tiles and fuses attention scores, softmax, and value aggregation to reduce memory traffic, primarily during prefill.

descriptions.zh-CN: 面向单 Token Decode 的向量化 Flash Attention 路径，读取 KV Cache 并生成注意力输出。
descriptions.en-US: A vectorized flash-attention path for single-token decode that reads the KV cache and produces attention output.

descriptions.zh-CN: 按均方根归一化隐藏状态，并可融合权重缩放，是 Transformer 层的标准归一化步骤。
descriptions.en-US: Normalizes hidden states by their root mean square and may fuse weight scaling in Transformer layers.

descriptions.zh-CN: 根据门控分数为每个 Token 选择 Top-K 专家，并生成后续专家计算所需的路由信息。
descriptions.en-US: Selects the top-k experts for each token from gating scores and produces routing metadata for expert computation.

descriptions.zh-CN: 整理专家索引和 Token 分组，为分组专家矩阵乘法准备输入布局。
descriptions.en-US: Organizes expert indices and token groups to prepare inputs for grouped expert matrix multiplication.

descriptions.zh-CN: 执行 Gated DeltaNet 状态更新，用于混合注意力架构中的递归状态计算。
descriptions.en-US: Updates Gated DeltaNet recurrent state in hybrid attention architectures.

descriptions.zh-CN: 把浮点激活临时量化为 Q8_1 布局，供量化矩阵乘法使用。
descriptions.en-US: Temporarily quantizes floating-point activations to Q8_1 layout for quantized matrix multiplication.

descriptions.zh-CN: 将 Q6_K 权重块解量化为计算所需的浮点或半精度表示。
descriptions.en-US: Dequantizes Q6_K weight blocks into floating-point or half-precision values for computation.

descriptions.zh-CN: 对张量执行支持广播的逐元素乘法。
descriptions.en-US: Performs broadcast-capable element-wise multiplication between tensors.

descriptions.zh-CN: 对张量执行支持广播的逐元素加法。
descriptions.en-US: Performs broadcast-capable element-wise addition between tensors.

descriptions.zh-CN: 在浮点、半精度或其他张量表示之间转换数据类型。
descriptions.en-US: Converts tensor values between floating-point, half-precision, or other representations.

descriptions.zh-CN: 根据索引从权重矩阵读取指定行，常用于词嵌入或专家权重选择。
descriptions.en-US: Gathers indexed rows from a weight matrix for token embeddings or expert-weight selection.

descriptions.zh-CN: 计算并应用向量 L2 归一化，使向量具有单位范数。
descriptions.en-US: Computes and applies L2 normalization so vectors have unit norm.
